note: XXIV fill shots, recipe B, the sky of 4-6 Oct 1893
style: An oil painting of 1893, painted alla prima in the manner of Sargent, Atkinson Grimshaw and the Victorian narrative painters: visible loose brushstrokes, thick impasto in the lights, thin transparent glazes in the shadows, soft lost edges, broken colour, canvas weave showing through; pale, cool early-October daylight in England: a low autumn sun a third of the way up the sky, soft silvery light through thin high cloud, long cool shadows, colours muted and slightly grey-green, trees only beginning to turn; no golden glow. Horse-drawn traffic only, no motor cars. Figures small, unidealised. Not an illustration, not digital art. One single painting filling the whole 16:9 frame, no text, lettering, signature, border or black bars.

beats.text: Shot: very wide. The Thames at Purfleet on a pale grey October afternoon, 1893: the wide grey river, marsh and mudflats, a powder-magazine and a small pier, sailing barges and a steamer passing, the asylum's roofs among trees on the bank.
Shot: close, no people. A doctor's desk by a window on a pale afternoon: a brass phonograph with its horn, a row of wax cylinders in their cases, typed sheets, a pen; cool daylight.
Shot: far. The asylum garden on a pale October afternoon, clipped yews, gravel paths, fallen leaves, a stone urn; a young woman in a dark dress walking small and alone, her back turned.

Shot: establishing, very wide. Doolittle's Wharf below the Tower of London on a grey October afternoon, 1893: warehouses, cranes, lighters, a tall three-masted sailing ship at the quay, carts and dock-hands, the Tower small in the haze.
Shot: establishing, far. The gothic red-brick asylum at Purfleet on a grey October afternoon, thin cool sunlight, a carriage on the gravel, clipped yews, a stone statue.

Shot: wide. A London gunsmith's shop in pale daylight, 1893: racks of rifles and shotguns behind glass, brass and walnut, a counter with cartridge boxes, a gentleman small at the counter seen from behind.

Shot: wide interior, no faces. A bedroom at the asylum on a pale October morning: cool light through a tall window across a white bed where a young woman sleeps, small, her face turned away; a water jug on a stand.
Shot: very wide. The Thames estuary at morning, pale silver light, the river opening to the grey North Sea, a few sails far off, gulls, mudflats.
